verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms rocm.docs.amd.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content pointing to sub-project docs, giving an agent a genuine machine-readable entry point into the Radeon/ROCm software docs relevant to this GPU. Missing for 10: no evidence of llms.txt coverage at finer granularity (e.g., per-page) and no OpenAPI/agent API surface (which 404s), so agentic doc access is present but not comprehensive.
